title: GTA 6 gets 8 Game Awards nominations before launch 🏆
subject: gta6
description:
Should an unreleased game be up for Game of the Year? 👇

GTA 6 earned 8 nominations at The Game Awards 2026, tied with Control Resonant and Resident Evil Requiem for the most, two days before its November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Winners are revealed December 10 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

Sources: Video Games Chronicle (Nov 17, 2026), Xbox Wire (Nov 17, 2026), Beebom
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 earned 8 Game Awards nominations before launch.
Geoff Keighley revealed the list on November 17, two days before the November 19 release.
That ties Control Resonant and Resident Evil Requiem for the most this year.
Manni L. Perez is up for Best Performance as Lucia. Game of the Year rivals include 007 First Light and Phantom Blade Zero.
Fan voting opened before a single review was published.
Winners are named on December 10 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.
